lede: The week's most important meeting is Tuesday's Town Council, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code goes to third reading — a vote that would rewrite Telluride's Land Use Code to change what property owners can do with landscaping and historic structures in the name of fire mitigation. Ridgway's council also holds a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint work session on its state-mandated Housing Action Plan. On the county side, the Planning Commission takes up an energy code update that would reshape building standards for new construction.

notable.stake: Third reading vote on wildfire code that rewrites landscaping and historic review rules.
Public hearing on Hyde Subdivision resubdivision plus state-mandated housing plan work session.
